title: docs(releases): 18.5.0 release notes, the v18 line overview and its upgrading row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMKjdYGd1ASsfeFTXYf2bZ4)_

Fixes #33798

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新增 18.5.0 发布说明页 `content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx`（沿用 18-4 的骨架，五段按「读者要做什么」分组），在 `meta.json` 中排在 18-4 之前；按维护者追加的要求把 `v18/index.mdx` 重写为 v18 产品线总览（不再写成 18.0.0 GA 页，`next` 改述为 `0.0.0-next-时间戳` 快照，数据库仪式只留链接到 18-0），并加上 18.5.0 条目；升级页「Per-release specifics」表加 v18.5.0 行；`handwritten-docs.json` 由生成器补一行。
- **为什么改**：维护者要求在 18.5.0 发版前写好发布说明（「18.5的版本发布说明可以开始安排写了」），并指出 v18 总说明写得不对（「我记得v18总的版本说明写的也不对」）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改文档，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。页面全部数字取自 Version Packages PR #33097 头 `25559f43` 的 CHANGELOG 与 `npm view`，分类用发布脚本自己的 `classifyReleaseBullet`。页面是公开的，不写任何客户、下游项目或席位。
- **先看**：① `18-5.mdx` 的「需手动处理」节（45 条，每条写明变化和处理办法）；② 同页「自动迁移」表（22 条全是 semantic 条目，`os migrate meta` 只列出、不改写，页面如实说明）；③ 重写后的 `v18/index.mdx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`git fetch origin changeset-release/main && git show 25559f43 --diff-filter=D --name-only --format= | grep -c '^.changeset/'` 应输出 `283`；再加上 `main` 在 `b76df9a6` 之后新落地的 1 个 changeset（`1e65a389`，#33725），共 `284`，与页面「Changesets consumed」一致。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。版本 PR 合并前若再有 changeset 落地，由席位派发刷新。

## What changes

- **`content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx`** (new): the 18.5.0 page in 18-4.mdx's skeleton. A compile callout; a release-status blockquote that says 18.5.0 is not yet published; Highlights; Release facts, as measured (before the cut); What's new by kind: 需手动处理 (45, each line saying what now answers differently and what to do, with its commit and pull request), 自动迁移 (21, a table with what to do and the ADR-0087 id), 新增能力 (70, by area), 语义变化 (1), 其他修复 (146, counted by area, with the fixes that bear on an upgrade grouped by capability); Console (Studio); an Upgrade checklist for an 18.4.0 app, compiled and not walked.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx`**: rewritten as the v18 line overview, as the maintainer asked on the card (triage record 6893347748). The status blockquote now says 18.4.0 is the newest release and 18.5.0 is next; a table lists every 18.x release with its npm date and page; "Coming from 17.x" links the organization-ownership ceremony down to the 18.0.0 page and the upgrading guide instead of repeating it; "How a breaking stage lands on this line" (anchor kept: three pages link it) describes the level rule, protocol 18 and the two npm channels as they are now (`next` is a `0.0.0-next-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` snapshot of `main`, ADR-0125 amendments of 2026-11-05/06); the per-release list gains the 18.5.0 entry.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/meta.json`**: `18-5` ahead of `18-4`.
- **`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`**: the v18.5.0 row of "Per-release specifics", and nothing else.
- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`**: +1 line, written by `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write` (the generator #33137 used).

No CHANGELOG is edited, no other release page is touched, and no tag, publish, `version` script or release-workflow act was taken.

## Why

The maintainer asked for the 18.5.0 notes ahead of the cut, and on the card added that the v18 overview page was wrong: it still read as the 18.0.0 GA page and described pre mode and `18.0.0-next.N` as current.

## How the page was compiled

- Source: Version Packages PR #33097 at head `25559f43` (one commit; its parent `b76df9a6` is `main` at the start of this work, so the PR covers every changeset on `main`). The 122 CHANGELOG sections it writes were read with `getChangelogEntry` and split with `splitChangelogEntry`; `Updated dependencies` bullets and two dependency-list fragments dropped; deduplicated on full text: 283 entries, equal to the 283 changesets the commit deletes. Refreshed at head `1e5ae1d459` (addendum 6893969023): `main` at `1e65a389` carries one more changeset, `.changeset/33689-ai-action-confirmation-elicited.md` (#33725), read from its file the same way, so the page holds 284.
- Each entry placed with `classifyReleaseBullet`: 45 / 22 / 70 / 1 / 146. Levels: 39 `minor`, 245 `patch`. Breaking: 67 (24 `minor`, 43 `patch`); 62 commits since 18.4.0 carry `!`.
- Every breaking line was written from its changeset's BREAKING / "What to do" / "The fix" paragraph; the 22 registered entries (23 registry ids) were checked to exist as `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.*.ts` files, all semantic entries (no conversion).
- The new-capability lines are the changesets' summaries with the conventional prefix removed; two are shortened or put in plain words (`534e115`, `ba32e79`).
- Areas are placed mechanically from summary scope and packages, as the callout says.

The breaking walk (all 61 `!` commits of `@objectstack/cli@18.4.0..b76df9a6`, each mapped to its changeset and section, plus the five breaking changesets from commits without `!`, and the card's candidate list kept/dropped with reasons) is in the project file `pm-orders/devx/33798-breaking-ledger.md`. Summary: all 61 kept; candidates dropped: #33268 (only the ADR text landed, no implementation on `main`), the hook refusal catalogue (#33214 → `53f5a4c` is additive, listed under 新增能力), dataset metrics for the ask agent and model-picker multipliers (not landed), the SQL-first rule (an AGENTS.md rule, no changeset).

## Verification

Local gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this diff at `a8ae5b50af`: **61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (`--ran` reconciliation exit 0). `--tier`: no path-derived mandate; 906 changed lines, under the 3,000 threshold.

<details><summary>Gate record</summary>

- Prerequisites: `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/lint..." build` and `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/client-react..." build`, both under `os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT exit 0.
- First pass: 60 of 61 exit 0; `check:skill-examples` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `client-react` had no `.d.ts`). After the client SDK closure build it exits 0 ("346 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)").
- The page-reading gates, all exit 0: `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs` (and `--strict`), `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check-affected-docs.mjs`, `check:role-word`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check-section-landing-index.mjs`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-links.mjs`, `check-issue-citations.mjs` / `check:issue-citations`, `check-docs-section-name.mjs`, `check-doc-route-spelling.mjs --advisory`, and the seven `@objectstack/spec` readers.
- The full record is in the project file `pm-orders/devx/33798-gates-ran.txt`.

</details>

<details><summary>Page render check</summary>

The three touched pages and 18-4.mdx (positive control) compile with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 + `remark-gfm` 4.0.1 (the docs site's MDX compiler): `18-5.mdx` 129,315 bytes of JS, `v18/index.mdx` 20,189, `upgrading.mdx` 76,568, `18-4.mdx` 324,138. Negative control: a one-line file with an unclosed brace fails the same script. The full `next build` of the docs site was not run.

</details>

<details><summary>Facts measured, and where</summary>

- `git show 25559f43 --diff-filter=D --name-only` → 283 changesets deleted; `ls .changeset` at `b76df9a6` → 283; at `1e65a389` → 284.
- Published set at `25559f43`: 110 non-private packages, all `18.5.0` (75 `@objectstack/*`, `create-objectstack`, 34 `@object-ui/*`), the same name set as at `@objectstack/cli@18.4.0`; `@object-ui/app-shell` versions `18.4.1`, private.
- `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags` → `latest` `18.4.0`, `next` `0.0.0-next-20261115100430`; npm `time` for 18.0.0–18.4.0 gives the index table's dates; no `18.x.y-` prerelease after 18.0.0 on npm.
- `git ls-remote --tags origin 'refs/tags/@objectstack/spec@18.5*'` → none.
- 334 first-parent commits `@objectstack/cli@18.4.0..b76df9a6`; 61 with a `!` subject; new CLI command file `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-side-copies.ts`.
- `PROTOCOL_VERSION` = `'18.0.0'` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The 自动迁移 heading overstates this release.** `classifyReleaseBullet` puts every breaking entry with a `registered` ADR-0087 marker under 自动迁移 ("migrated for you"), but all 22 of 18.5.0's registered entries are semantic entries, which `os migrate meta` lists under "manual change(s) require your judgment" and does not convert. The page keeps the heading so it agrees with the GitHub Release body, and says plainly that nothing is rewritten. Noted, not filed: it is the release script's section name, a reading the seat may want to raise with the maintainer.
- **Two widenings open with their declaration line**, so the classifier reads no declaration and files them under 其他修复 (`3eac63a`, `5604aeb`); the page names them. No narrowing opens that way in this release.
- **The page is written before the cut.** Its status blockquote, the index blockquote and the index table say 18.5.0 is not yet published. After the cut the seat's refresh owes: the two blockquotes, the index table row's date, the release facts (version commit, tags, npm), any changeset that landed after `b76df9a6`, and `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`'s v18 entry status `(current series: …)`, which `check-release-section-coverage --strict` will ask for once `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` carries `## 18.5.0`. That root index entry still describes v18 by its 18.0.0 prerelease story too; it is outside this card's file surface.
- **The order's "Fixes customers waited on" section is replaced** by notable fixes grouped by capability, per the maintainer's later word on the card (triage record 6893327884): the page names no customer, downstream project or seat.
- **Read heads.** `main` at `b76df9a6` and Version PR #33097 at `25559f43`. While this ran, `main` moved one commit: `1e65a389` (#33725, `feat(spec)!:`, a declared-gated action on an AI door confirmed by a person through MCP elicitation, with a new protocol-18 semantic entry `action-requires-confirmation-elicited`). It is not on this page; it shares no file with this diff, and the refresh before the cut picks it up with the Version PR's next head.
- No changeset: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (docs content plus a script data file), so `skip-changeset` is declared.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no code; CI runs lint)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. (`content/docs/releases/v18/` is this card's subject: a docs-only release-notes PR, dispatched per card by the seat)
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
